additional_concerns: Footnote 7 places the holistic designation assessment in cases below 50% of NAV. The representation does not state that context, but its OR expression preserves the classification outcome when exposure is at least 50%. No additional below-threshold prerequisite should be imposed on an already operative designation without evidence about its terms.

Exposure measurement, LAF identification and the existence and temporal effect of an SFC designation are supplied judgments, not implemented determinations. Formula correspondence cannot establish those inputs.

The source supplies no persistence or declassification rule. The question appropriately limits FALSE to absence of the two routes at the assessment time; it must not become a conclusion that the Fund is non-complex.
The three supplied missing dependency IDs have no identifying metadata connecting them to particular authorities. No catalogue match can be made.

The global conflict-blocking rule is an evidentiary execution policy, not a requirement stated by the circular. It can prevent a result despite one independently established classification route; this is not itself a contrary legal classification.
